argument:
Visa's growth and cash generation are compelling, but operating margin is lower than a year earlier and no authenticated valuation discount has been established. The settlement hearing has not removed legal uncertainty. A good business can therefore remain an insufficiently priced purchase without showing fundamental distress.

The trend is positive, yet price is already 19.98% above SMA200, while MACD momentum is cooling and five-bar performance is negative. That combination limits the claim of timely entry. Measured sizing helps manage exposure but cannot substitute for evidence that expected returns justify the current price.
key_points: No verified valuation margin of safety
Positive long trend has cooling short momentum
rebuttal_to_previous: Independent trend support is conceded; its distance above SMA200 and cooling momentum weaken the inference that this is the best immediate entry.
